articles.title: More on the pending oversight hearings: State of Crypto
articles.snippet: New letters show the widening range of Congressional committees that will be probing the presidential administration — and the crypto collateral that may be swept up.

articles.title: Bitcoin's quantum security challenge extends to bridges, custodians and millions of coins
articles.snippet: Quantum computers can’t break Bitcoin network’s security yet, but Leo Fan warns that upgrading it and moving funds could take longer than expected.

articles.title: Bitcoin nodes could be stalled by repeating one ID 50,000 times. AI found the bug
articles.snippet: Bitcoin Core shipped fixes on Friday for a bug flagged by Loupe, an open-source scanner from Block’s Spiral that uses AI agents to examine bitcoin code.

articles.title: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest piled into Anthropic IPO, buying $90 million worth of shares
articles.snippet: ARK Invest snapped up $90 million in Anthropic stock across six funds during the AI maker’s historic Nasdaq debut while offloading Nvidia shares amid leadership turmoil.

articles.title: Bitcoin briefly drops to $17K on Kraken, exchange upholds trades
articles.snippet: Kraken said all orders were processed correctly and found no evidence of a security breach or compromised accounts.
